root_cause: The `/addtask` POST route handler in `index.js` receives `req.body.newtask` from the user form. Without proper validation and trimming on the server side (or if empty/whitespace strings bypass client-side checks), empty strings or whitespace-only inputs are allowed to be pushed into the `task` array, resulting in blank items appearing in the task list.
evidence: In `views/index.ejs`, the form `<input type="text" name="newtask" placeholder="add new task" required>` allows whitespace-only input to pass browser validation if spaces are entered.
proposed_fix: Ensure server-side validation in `index.js` checks that `req.body.newtask` exists, is a string, and is non-empty after trimming whitespace before calling `task.push(newTask.trim())`. In `views/index.ejs`, optional pattern validation or trimming can also be enforced.
verification_plan: Leave the task input empty or enter only spaces, then click 'Add Task'.
Confirm that no blank entry is added to the 'Added Task' list.
